Neither statement establishes which year or sheet covers Maribor. Map sheet retrieval remains pending.

products.coverage: Maribor cadastral municipalities; per-sheet coverage unverified
products.access: Franciscan and later cadastral plans viewable via eZKN; download terms unverified

products.title: GURS Ciklično aerofotografiranje Slovenije (CAS) historical aerial photographs
products.coverage: Periodic nationwide airborne photography since 1975; 1985 onward three-year cycles and 1997–1999 surveys documented. Maribor source flight strips, dates, orientation files and actual coverage not yet checked
products.known_distortions: Film-camera perspective and historical orientation/georeferencing may require reconstruction; project-specific residuals unmeasured
products.access: GURS historical aerial archive, with Geodetski inštitut Slovenije authorized to distribute historical photography. Digital scans with absolute orientation reported for parts of 1998 and 1999; obtain flight/block inventory and per-image conditions before site claims

products.title: Early Slovenian DOF5 digital orthophoto production (1994–1995 initial series)
products.coverage: Early national production: GURS records 74 DOF5 sheets and 14 DOF25 sheets made in 1994; since 1995 issued DOF5 only. Maribor coverage in those particular years has not been verified
products.access: Research the original 1994–1995 DOF5 index and issue dates via GURS. The historical source is not necessarily downloadable in current GURS public distribution. No sheet acquired

products.title: Archives of Slovenia SI AS 177 Franciscan cadastre for Styria
products.publisher: Arhiv Republike Slovenije (Archives of the Republic of Slovenia)
products.coverage: Historic cadastral municipalities in Styria; Maribor-target parcel/sheet list not yet inspected in VAČ
products.known_distortions: Historic Austrian cadastral geometry; scanned high-quality copy and contemporary EPSG:3794 georeferencing not undertaken
products.absence_presence_reliability: No evidence of 1990–1999 presence or absence; use only to research durable earlier geometry and cadastral settlement pattern with independent continuity evidence
products.access: SI AS 177 fonds enumerated in national public-data portal; viewer copies are available through VAČ; high-resolution archival copies require reading-room process. Distinct archival provenance from GURS eZKN viewer and not evidence of the game's period
